Two Towers Walk Into an Earthquake

THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

The tower test

THE SCENE

Your engineering class built two small towers, Tower A and Tower B. You host the class podcast, and today you must pick one tower. The class tests each tower on a shake table. The shake table moves like an earthquake. Rule one: a tower must stand for 30 seconds. Rule two: if both towers stand, the cheaper one wins. Four people each have one number you need.

THE HISTORY

This podcast is about the Torre Latinoamericana in Mexico City. Leonardo and Adolfo Zeevaert planned it on soft, wet ground. In 1957 a big earthquake hit, and the tower stood. It stood again in 1985 and 2017.
